romanized_text:
arav aur riy ek hi skul men padhate the aur pakke dost the. ek din skul men vijnana mele ki ghoshan hui. arav bahut utsahit hokar riy ke pas daudaa aur bol, riya, hamen is bar kuch jabaradasta banan hai. agar ham jit gae to pure skul men hamar nam hog. riy ne hansate hue kaha, bilkula, chal aj se hi shuru karate hain.

donon ne milakar ek chot robot banane k phaisal kiya. lekin kuch hi dinon men mushkilen ane lagin. ek sham robot k sarkit bara-bara jal jata tha. arav jhunjhal kara bol, yaha kam hi nahin kara rah. mainne itani mehanat ki aur sab bekar j rah hai. riy ne use shant karate hue kaha, itana pareshan mat ho, ham phir se koshish karenge.

usi rat arav apani dadi ke pas gaya aur sari bat batai. dadi ghar ki sabase bujaurg sadasy thin. arav ne kaha, dadi, mujhe lagat hai main har jaung. dadi ne pyar se usak sir sahalay aur bolin, beta, dhairy rakho. mehanat kabhi bekar nahin jati. har asaphalat kuch sikhati hai. arav ko unaki bat se nai himmat mili.

agale din vijnana mele men adhyapak sharm sabhi pariyojanaon ki janch kara rahe the. ve apani sakhati ke lie jane jate the. unhonne arav se puch, tumane yaha robot kaise banay aur isak asali upayog kya hai? arav ne shanti se har saval k uttar diya. adhyapak sharm ne sir hilakar kaha, tumhari mehanat sapha dikhai deti hai.

parinam ki ghoshan hui aur arav tath riy ki tim pratham ai. riy khushi se chillai, hama jit gae! mujhe yakin hi nahin ho rah. arav ne hansate hue kaha, mainne kaha tha n, ham kamal kara denge. us sham donon doston ne apani jit k jashn manay aur dadi ko dhanyavad kaha jinaki baton ne unhen kabhi har nahin manane di.

key_events: Announcement of a science fair at the school

Riy laughs and agrees to start the project immediately

Arav gains new courage from his grandmother’s words

neutral_script.dialogue:
Arav: School mein science fair aane wala hai, aur main soch raha hoon ki hum ek zabardast project banayein.  
Riy: Hahaha, sahi hai! Main turant shuru karne ke liye taiyar hoon.  
Arav: Great! Chaliye, pehle ideas brainstorm karte hain.

neutral_script.dialogue:
Arav: "Riy, chalo ek chhota robot banate hain, ek simple prototype se shuru karte hain."  
Riy: "Theek hai, Arav. Agar fir se aag lagti hai, toh hum dhyaan se testing karenge, aur main promise karta hoon ki hum phir se try karenge."  
Arav: "Shukriya, Riy. Hum isse sudhaar karenge aur phir se koshish karenge."

neutral_script.dialogue:
Arav: Grandmother, main robot banane mein phir se fail ho gaya, sab kuch bekar lag raha hai.  
Grandmother: Arav, dhairya rakho. Hard work kabhi bekar nahi jaata; har ek choti galti ek seekh hai.  
Arav: Shukriya, Grandma. Aapke shabdon se mujhe nayi himmat mil rahi hai.

neutral_script.dialogue:
Arav: "Sir, maine is robot ko modular design se banaya hai, jisme sensors aur AI algorithm integrated hain, taki yeh real-time data analyse kar sake."  
Adhyapak Sharm: "Bahut accha, Arav. Iski real-world applications dekh kar mujhe lagta hai ki yeh smart agriculture aur disaster management mein kaafi upyogi hoga."  
Arav: "Shukriya, Adhyapak. Aapke feedback se mujhe aur motivation milti hai ki main is project ko aur bhi improve karun."

final_script:
# HINGLISH SCREENPLAY

## SCENE_01
*Location: school*

Arav: School mein science fair aane wala hai, aur note chhapna ho gaya, main toh soch raha hoon ki project banaya.
Riy: Hahaha, mahoul hai! Main turant shuru karne ke liye taiyar hoon.
Arav: Great! Koi chaliye kaatil aur ideas brainstorm karte hain.

---

## SCENE_02
*Location: Their workshop or lab*

Arav: Riy, chalo ekdum simple robot banate hain, ek simple prototype se shuru karte hain.
Riy: Theek hai, Arav, yaar jackpot ho gaya hai! Agar fir se aag lagti hai, toh mujhe test kar diya, promise hi thi.
Arav: "Shukriya, Riy. Hum isse sudhaar karenge aur phir se koshish karenge."

---

## SCENE_03
*Location: Arav’s grandmother’s home*

Arav: Grandmother, main robot banane mein phir se fail ho gaya, bohot hard hai yaar.
Grandmother: Arav, dhairya rakho. Hard work kabhi bekar nahi jaata; har ek choti galti ek seekh hai.
Arav: Shukriya, Grandma. Aapke shabdon se mujhe nayi himmat mil rahi hai.

---

## SCENE_04
*Location: Vijnana Mele (science fair)*

Arav: "Sir, maine is robot ko modular design se banaya hai, jisme sensors aur AI algorithm integrated hain, taki yeh real-time data analyse kar sake."
Adhyapak Sharm: "Bahut accha, Arav. Iski real-world applications dekh kar mujhe lagta hai ki yeh smart agriculture aur disaster management mein kaafi upyogi hoga."
Arav: "Shukriya, Adhyapak. Aapke feedback se mujhe aur motivation milti hai ki main is project ko aur bhi improve karun."

---

## SCENE_05
*Location: event venue*

Arav: Result aaya, aur hum dono first place jeet gaye hain, ab machayenge! 
Riy: Sach mein? Yeh toh kat gaya hai, bahut hi anokha lag raha hai!
Arav: "Humein apni dadi ka dhanyavaad karna chahiye, unke support ke bina yeh mumkin nahi hota."

---
